notes: backend.host and backend.port configure the Russound TCP hardware endpoint; use backend.device and backend.baud for direct serial hardware access.
backend.poll_interval_seconds configures how often backend state changes are polled while SSE clients are connected (minimum 1.0).
backend.protocol_audit_log_file optionally enables protocol-audit logging of all TX/RX RNET frames.
inputs.id values are numeric and start at 1.

inputs[].playback_output optionally maps physical wiring to an agent_id/output_id; the selected station supplies the runtime display name, while name stays the fallback. Remove this binding when no playback agent is configured.
zones[].controller, zones[].zone, and zones[].keypad_id describe the Russound hardware mapping; keypad_id defaults to 1.
shortcuts[].source is an input id, not an index.
